notes: TADS/sight session. Two distinct flicker causes separated here. (1) DLSS upscaling: ['Upscaling']='DLSS' flickers violently from launch and never settles; setting it OFF fixes it with no other change -- bisected as a single variable. (2) Enabling TADS in the CPG seat flickers for a few seconds then settles, and the sight image renders correctly -- first-use shader compilation, not corruption. TEDAC_LCD_AH64, MFD_LCD_AH64_* and the mainDepthBuffer/uiTargetColor/uiTargetDepth render targets are runtime names, not shipped files, and the sight works despite them. So the IC-risky MFD/sight texture conversion patch appears unnecessary on 2.9.28.26385.
